gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent WHO grade 4 glioblastoma or gliosarcoma, including molecular features of glioblastoma and WHO grade 4 astrocytoma or WHO grade high grade glioma.
All grade 4 gliomas that have relapsed more than once may be included, as the prognosis of multiply recurrent grade 4 glioma patients may not differ based on IDH mutation status.

candidate_evidence.quote: In this study, the investigators propose to combine retifanlimab with radiation therapy (RT) and bevacizumab with or without epacadostat in the treatment of recurrent glioblastoma (GBM).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Disease must have recurred, and patient must be a candidate for re-irradiation and bevacizumab. Any number of recurrences are allowed.

role_evidence.quote: Retifanlimab and Epacadostat in Combination With Radiation and Bevacizumab in Patients With Recurrent Gliomas
Retifanlimab (other names: INCMGA00012): -Will be supplied by Incyte

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: synergy between RT and immune modulators to produce more robust anti-tumor immune response

role_evidence.quote: Epacadostat will be administered orally at 400 mg BID.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: synergy between RT and immune modulators to produce more robust anti-tumor immune response

role_evidence.quote: Bevacizumab will be given intravenously at a dose of 10 mg/kg on Days 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle.
Disease must have recurred, and patient must be a candidate for re-irradiation and bevacizumab.

coder_notes: Two sequential non-randomised experimental arms; retifanlimab, bevacizumab and re-irradiation in both, epacadostat added in Regimen B. Retifanlimab is the only investigational agent in Regimen A (experimental_monotherapy there) and one of two in Regimen B; coded experimental_combination overall (candidate either way). Bevacizumab given identically in all arms = soc_backbone. Population includes WHO grade 4 astrocytoma and multiply recurrent grade 4 gliomas regardless of IDH status, so coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named with historical terminology. IDH mentioned in eligibility only to say status does not matter; not an entry requirement, so no biomarker row.
